availability.cagr: available when positive finite initial capital, ordered positive finite NAV, explicit UTC anchor, and positive elapsed period are valid
availability.calmar: available only when CAGR and non-zero maximum drawdown are available
availability.hard_filter: available only when maximum drawdown is available; pass when maximum drawdown is less than or equal to 0.20
availability.maximum_drawdown: available when the initial capital and ordered positive finite NAV series are valid
availability.sharpe: available only with risk-free evidence, at least two NAV points, and non-zero sample variance
availability.total_net_return: available when positive finite initial capital and ordered positive finite NAV series are valid

rules.cagr: final NAV divided by initial capital raised to 365 divided by actual UTC calendar days from initial_capital_at, minus one
rules.maximum_drawdown: include initial capital as the first running peak and use the greatest peak-to-NAV fractional decline
rules.returns: include initial capital to first NAV simple return; subsequent returns are simple NAV-to-NAV returns
rules.risk_free: convert annual risk-free rate to a daily geometric rate using sessions_per_year; use sample variance and annualize by square root of sessions_per_year
rules.sharpe: mean daily simple excess return divided by sample standard deviation, annualized by square root of sessions_per_year
rules.total_net_return: final NAV divided by initial capital minus one

semantics.costs: costs already included in NAV are not subtracted again
semantics.data_grade: preserve the input grade and never promote it
semantics.missing_evidence: return stable unavailable reason codes; do not fabricate zero or infinity
semantics.readiness: policy evidence does not calculate performance or make a hard-filter decision
semantics.timestamps: store and evaluate timestamps in UTC; CAGR uses UTC calendar-date difference
